name: Groot Melkhuis
funFact: This café began as a farm in 1874, selling fresh milk from cows grazing where Festina’s tennis courts now stand. Park maintenance was partly funded by its rent. The present house gained its surrounding ground-floor extensions in 1938.
description: A white park café with a shallow hipped roof, glazed veranda and waterside terrace, beside a playground.
